units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 147a:11">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>יו״ט … ב׳ וכ׳</he> when the day of Pentecosts is bright, sow wheat; opp. <cite ref="B00830"><he>בָּלוּל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Arakhin 1:9">Tosef. Arakh. I, 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:2">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אם ב׳ וכ׳</he> if the case is as clear to thee as the morning, speak out (thy opinion).
<cite ref="Pesachim 50a:6">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>עולם ב׳</he> a rightly-conducted world, opp. <cite ref="E00727"><he>הפוך</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:15">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> <he>יחזור … הב׳ לו</he> he must begin to re-read from the place which he is certain of having read correctly.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:12">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>חלוט ב׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01020"><he>חָלַט</he> I</cite>; <he>תבשיל ב׳</he> real boiling (about which there is no legal doubt).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:2:3">Y. Yeb. IV, 5ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>חלב ב׳</he> ascertained existence of forbidden fat.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:8:2">Y. Gitt. IX, 50ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קיים שריר וב׳</he> (the formula) valid, firm and established.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:6:3">Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵃ</cite> top <he>כהן ב׳</he> a priest of undoubted genealogy; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>הב׳ שבהם</he> the best one among them.—Pl. <he>בְּרוּרִים</he>, <he>בְּרוּרִין</he>. Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵃ bot. <he>הב׳ שבאחיך</he> the chosen among thy brethren (whose genealogy has been established; v. supra); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>.
